title: views block, schema 2: how nodes are drawn
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §4 (K-R30..K-R36). An object keyed by view id; a node uses views[<its id>] by default or names view ids in node.view. Four kinds: tiles (DZI pyramid), image (one picture, no slicing), schematic (automatic layout, no coordinates), model3d (a 3D manifest for the generic viewer). A view with a frame (tiles, image, model3d) gives child nodes a coordinate system for at / anchor.

file.description: Relative to the pack folder (the first pack: relative to map/): letters, digits, _ . / - only, no .. segment. After URL resolution it must still lie under the pack's base (K-R64).

regions.description: Region table of this view: inline [{id, at | poly}] or a file (a v2 region array, or a schema-1 points file whose markers[] carry {id, nx, ny, r}). Nodes point into it with anchor (default: their own id).

home.description: Initial framing: focus node, visible width in extent units, phone core rectangle [x, y, w, h] (0..1).

open.description: locate (default): opens whenever its node is the target; enter: only when the user enters the node, e.g. a landmark's 3D model (K-R33, K-R34).

extent.description: Real size [width, height] in metres; enables scale and distances. Aspect must match the image.

variants.description: Base map per time period id (vars.periods); missing period = src.

alt.description: One alternate base map the user can switch to.

items.description: High-resolution tiles overlaid when the view zooms into bounds.

media.description: A picture of the media block (K-R101) as the frame: an alternative to src. Needs src or media.

layout.description: Automatic layout of the node's subtree. Default tree.

depth.description: How many levels below the node are drawn. Default 2.

model3d.description: manifest = the generic 3D viewer's manifest (hotspots are this view's regions). A pack-specific page is only possible through x-page, a legacy form kept for the page that ships with the engine; it is ignored in every foreign pack (K-R36, K-R63). The manifest itself is pack data under K-R64 (S8 gives it a v2 schema).
